column1: # aV2P 2.2 -> native alpaka 3.0.0 CMake option mapping
# Machine readable source for the Phase 4 migration guide. Fields:
#   local       - aV2P-local option with no native alpaka equivalent
#   on          - when the legacy option is ON set the native option ON
#   forward     - forward the legacy value to the native option when it differs
#                 from the legacy default; never override an explicit native value
#   unsupported - FATAL_ERROR when the value differs from the legacy default
#   cuda_unsupported - FATAL_ERROR when the value differs from default and CUDA is enabled
#   sycl_unsupported - FATAL_ERROR when the value differs from default and SYCL is enabled
#   sycl_warn   - WARNING when the value differs from default and SYCL is enabled
#   sycl_device - backward/forwarding oneAPI device-kind options: when SYCL is enabled
#                 value is mirrored into the native oneAPI device-kind option
